title: Polkadot 2.0 Development Course - Introduction to Blockchain
description:
Blockchain is more than just Bitcoin—it’s a groundbreaking technology that’s reshaping industries worldwide. In this video, we’ll break down the basics of what blockchain is, how it works, and why it’s considered revolutionary.

💡 What you’ll learn:
- The core concept of blockchain technology
- Key features: decentralization, transparency, and security
- Real-world applications of blockchain in the financial world—from payments and remittances to decentralized finance (DeFi) and beyond

Whether you’re new to blockchain or looking to understand its financial impact, this video is your perfect starting point.
